# truenas_rsync_task (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS rsync task by description. Rsync tasks have no name field; desc serves as the lookup key.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `desc` (String) Task description to look up.

### Read-Only

- `archive` (Boolean) Make rsync run recursively, preserving symlinks, permissions, modification times, group, and special files.
- `compress` (Boolean) Reduce the size of the data to be transmitted.
- `delayupdates` (Boolean) Delay updating destination files until all transfers are complete.
- `delete` (Boolean) Delete files in the destination directory that do not exist in the source directory.
- `direction` (String) Whether data is PUSHed to or PULLed from the remote system.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this rsync task is enabled.
- `extra` (List of String) Additional rsync command-line options.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the rsync task.
- `mode` (String) Operating mechanism for rsync: MODULE (rsync module/daemon protocol) or SSH.
- `path` (String) Local filesystem path to synchronize.
- `preserveattr` (Boolean) Preserve extended attributes of files.
- `preserveperm` (Boolean) Preserve original file permissions.
- `quiet` (Boolean) Suppress informational messages from rsync.
- `recursive` (Boolean) Recursively transfer subdirectories.
- `remotehost` (String) IP address or hostname of the remote system.
- `remotemodule` (String) Name of the remote rsync module.
- `remotepath` (String) Path on the remote system to synchronize with.
- `remoteport` (Number) Port number for the SSH connection. Only applies when mode is SSH.
- `schedule` (Attributes) Cron schedule for when the rsync task should run. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule))
- `ssh_credentials` (Number) Keychain credential ID (of type SSH_CREDENTIALS) used to connect to the remote host in SSH mode.
- `times` (Boolean) Preserve modification times of files.
- `user` (String) Username to run the rsync task as.

<a id="nestedatt--schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule`

Read-Only:

- `dom` (String) Day of month.
- `dow` (String) Day of week (cron format, 7=Sunday).
- `hour` (String) Cron hour.
- `minute` (String) Cron minute.
- `month` (String) Month.
